It allows users to ask questions through natural language or receive proactive notifications about logistics issues, enabling quick actionable recommendations and cost savings. Key features include secure data integration with shipments, predictive rerouting suggestions, port congestion updates, and real-time tracking of late shipment rates across various routes. Icariot offers different subscription plans tailored for small logistics teams and large businesses, catering to the specific needs of each business.
candidates.rationale: Both are logistics visibility/intelligence platforms tracking shipments with proactive alerts and rerouting — direct competitor on product and market axes.

candidates.name: Lognow
candidates.description: Lognow is a SAP supply chain and logistics solutions provider that offers a variety of services to enhance operational efficiency in the logistics industry. Their main functionalities include digital supply chain management, warehouse automation, transport logistics, yard management, and analytics. Key features include tailored implementation and support for SAP S/4HANA, SAP MFS (Material Flow System), and SAP Fiori (Application Management System) modules, all designed to improve productivity, reduce costs, and facilitate better decision-making across various logistics operations. Lognow also provides 24/7 customer support and training programs to ensure effective use of SAP products.

votes.rationale: SAP implementation/consulting services firm for logistics, not a shipment-visibility platform product; serves the category rather than competing with project44.

candidates.name: Datatruck
candidates.description: Datatruck is a transportation management system (TMS) designed for logistics companies, including carriers and brokers. Its main functionality includes automating operations such as billing, payroll, and shipment tracking through AI-powered tools like TruckGPT and automated workflows. Key features include data analytics, mobile app access for managing loads, real-time load planning, and integration with other systems to enhance productivity and financial decision-making. The platform aims to streamline processes, reduce downtime, and improve overall efficiency in the trucking industry.
candidates.rationale: Both are logistics software platforms for freight/shipment tracking and carrier operations; TMS with real-time tracking is a direct comparable in supply-chain visibility space.
